title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Camanga, Municipality of Malangas, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay to Be Known as Dionisio Lopez, Sr. National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Camanga, Municipality of Malangas, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay to Be Known as Dionisio Lopez, Sr. National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Camanga, Thị trấn Malangas, Tỉnh Zamboanga Sibugay được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Dionisio Lopez, Sr.
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Camanga, เทศบาล Malangas, จังหวัด Zamboanga Sibugay ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Dionisio Lopez, Sr.
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Camanga, Kotamadya Malangas, Provinsi Zamboanga Sibugay dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Dionisio Lopez, Sr.
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Camanga, Perbandaran Malangas, Wilayah Zamboanga Sibugay dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Dionisio Lopez, Sr.

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Camanga, Municipality of Malangas, Province of Zamboanga Sibugay to be known as Dionisio Lopez, Sr. National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Dionisio Lopez, Sr. National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
